tasks.patch: cd build && deno run --allow-env --allow-read=soe-ja.sfc,"../Secret of Evermore (USA).sfc" --allow-write=. npm:rom-patcher@3.1.0-b create "../Secret of Evermore (USA).sfc" soe-ja.sfc -f bps
tasks.verify-patch: cd build && deno run --no-lock --allow-env --allow-read=.,"../Secret of Evermore (USA).sfc" --allow-write=. npm:rom-patcher@3.1.0-b patch "../Secret of Evermore (USA).sfc" soe-ja.bps && cmp "Secret of Evermore (USA) (patched).sfc" soe-ja.sfc && rm "Secret of Evermore (USA) (patched).sfc"
